phases.frontendCheck: Separate process wall time: tsrust check and TypeScript tsc --noEmit over the retained two-file projects. Includes process startup and source reads; excludes native backend. Type and ownership validation differ, so this is a frontend cost comparison, not equivalent validation coverage.
phases.frontendEmit: Separate tsrust emit process wall time including startup and source reads. No matched runtime throughput claim; observe generated source outside the timed interval.
phases.coldBuild: Native CLI build with a fresh isolated cache and the installed pinned backend. Includes backend verification, code emission, rustc, linking and cache publication. No dependency/toolchain downloads permitted.
phases.warmBuild: Same native source/backend/features with a populated isolated cache. Includes frontend and identity checks, lookup and copying the cached executable. Do not describe as frontend-only or rustc throughput.
phases.featureTransition: After a retained used project build, build the retained unused project in the same cache and verify helper exclusion and stdout. Correctness/invalidation witness, not a matched timing ratio. Existing dedicated identity tests isolate feature bytes from changed sources.

acceptance: Exact stdout from generated native executables and compiled TypeScript; emitted path helper only for used binding. Preserve complete source hashes, command/toolchain identities and samples in SQLite when measured. Never merge runs or report pending samples as measured.
